resolved.kind: execution-history metadata defect in new extension
resolved.observed: Future frozen segments had executed_s=0 but executed_until_s equal to their future start, after the checkpoint. A new assertion requiring executed_until_s <= checkpoint or null failed.
resolved.fix: Set executed_until_s=null for segments that have not begun. Keep actual simulated prefix end <= checkpoint and executed_s=0 for future segments.
resolved.rerun: Affected checkpoint tests and final complete suite rerun. Future commitments remain frozen without being represented as already executed.

resolved.observed: replan CLI given plan JSON [] raised AttributeError from raw.get, printed a traceback and exited 1 rather than clean input-error exit 2. New regression failed before the fix.
resolved.fix: Check plan root is a JSON object before extracting exported plan fields; raise InputError otherwise.
resolved.rerun: Both affected CLI tests and final complete suite rerun after the fix.

resolved.observed: Input capacity 3 kg, two tasks totalling 4 kg: evaluate_trip accepted a caller-supplied device capacity 4 kg rather than rejecting the conflicting device record. Expected InputError was not raised.
resolved.fix: Require the dictionary adapter device to match the validated Problem device before evaluating. Forged capacity or availability cannot override input parameters.
resolved.rerun: Affected regression then complete suite rerun successfully. Final status is read from validation-results.json.

resolved.observed: New test initially expected U2 ready at 130 s; independently reconstructed arithmetic gives 30+10+20+5+25+10+20=120 s.
resolved.fix: Correct expected ready time to 120 s. Production timeline calculation did not need changing.
resolved.rerun: All 10 checkpoint/boundary tests then passed; subsequent complete suite also passed.

resolved.observed: Run-OnTime-Python.cmd -m unittest invokes run_ontime.py and rejects unittest as a CLI subcommand (exit 1).
resolved.fix: Use Python -m unittest, or the new Run-Validation.cmd. Scheduling wrapper remains a CLI wrapper.
resolved.rerun: Python -m unittest executed the existing 53 tests successfully.
